I can't find a name for that contact. The only thing I have on Driftmoor Marine Freight's night dispatcher is a Coastal team note. It says engineering gave the night dispatcher a manual CSV patch for the failed tide-table import on Terminal B. It doesn't name the person, and I can't see any account files with contact details.

Kwame owns that account, so he's the best person to ask. Please also check with him before you send anything, because Driftmoor is outside pemberline.com. Any mail to an outside address, even a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval first. If you give me the contact's address, I can prepare the note and ask Ruth for that approval.
